context_and_flow.screen_type: Onboarding screen of a fitness tracking mobile application.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: User acquisition and onboarding to encourage sign-up or log-in by highlighting community scale.
ux_patterns: Hero image is a full-bleed photograph covering the entire screen background.
Text is white with a dark gradient overlay at the bottom to ensure readability.
The CTA button is a prominent high-saturation orange.
Visual style emphasizes community, health, and outdoor activity.

interaction_elements: The CTA button is a prominent high-saturation orange.
